claim: In the matching retail DLL, Referee.Start_HandlingDisturbing (0x0600509D) is a parameterless instance method with an exact 202-byte body. It resolves PlayerMan.inst.GetPlObj(TargetPlIdx), tests the result through UnityEngine.Object.op_Implicit, and returns when false. It writes Referee.State=18, writes PlDir=DecideRefereeDir(TargetPlIdx), then replaces PlDir with MatchMisc.ReversePlayerDirLR(PlDir). A local animation id starts at raw 1158 and is replaced with raw 1159 when the post-reversal PlDir is raw 1 or raw 5; that id is passed to FACT-0068 ReqRefereeAnm. It writes disturbedCnt = DisturbedTime[RefePrm.interfereTime]. On the resolved target player it calls FACT-0010 FormAnimator.ReqBasicAnm(animator.BasicSkillID,false,-1), then FACT-0006 FormAnimator.StartAnm(1), then writes Player.disturbingStep=1. Finally it calls FACT-0076 MatchSEPlayer.PlayRefereeVoice with raw argument 21 + FACT-0032 MatchRandom.Range(0,3), and returns. FACT-0085 pins the direct call at Process_ArrivedDestination IL+0x0216.
